messages.subject: Counting moose
parts:
A question about developing models associated with counting moose was asked recently at https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/623346/no-more-than-n-moose-but-how-many?noredirect=1#comment1162030_623346.

Given the description in the question, I've suggested looking at pcount to get an idea of how some have approached such a counting objective (although the OP would prefer a Bayesian solution). 

I have also suggested the OP ask the question at this forum but possibly some of you might want to give more specific advice at the other forum.

Jim
